<main class="doc guide">
<div class="wrap" markdown="1">

{% raw %}
Signing up is not attending. A player only gets credit for an event once an officer confirms they were there, and every report, rotation and Red Box reads that confirmed list. Recording needs the **Record attendance** permission (officers have it by default).

## Opening the panel

- When an event starts, the bot posts that it has started, with a **📋 Attendance** button. Press it.
- Or press **📋 Attendance** under the event's post.
- Or run `/attendance-start` and pick the event.

The panel is private to you. At the top it shows how many you have ticked, who they are, and who **signed up but is not ticked yet**. Players who signed up as Will Attend and have claimed their character start out ticked.

## Ticking names

**Name ranges.** The buttons such as `A–Ch · 12/41` each open a list of checkboxes for part of the alphabet. Tick everyone who came in that range and submit. Whatever is checked when you submit becomes that range's ticks, so you can also untick someone there.

**🔍 Find by name.** Type several names at once, separated by commas or new lines. Exact names (capitals don't matter) are ticked straight away; close matches and typos come back as buttons to pick from. This is the quickest way when you are reading names off the game screen.

**Shortcuts:**

- **📋 Tick all sign-ups**: everyone who signed up but is not ticked yet.
- **🔁 Same as last time**: the people confirmed at the last event of the same type.
- **Untick all**: starts again (it asks first).
- **📄 Import CSV** (premium plans): upload a file with a `name` column, or just one name per line. Exact matches are ticked; near ones are listed for Find by name.

## Saving

Nothing is saved until you press **✅ Finish & Save**. The saved list is exactly what is ticked: anyone unticked loses credit for that event. **Cancel** closes the panel and saves nothing.

Pressing Finish & Save twice, or on an old panel, is safe: the second press changes nothing.

## Fixing it later

Open the panel again from the event to correct it, and save. Officers can change an event's attendance for a number of days after it (7 by default); **Attendance Edit Window** on the **Features & limits** tab of `/guild-settings show` changes that, and 0 means no limit.

A panel left open and never saved is cleared away after a week. Nothing it held was saved.
{% endraw %}
